title: Art style (qwen/lora_dataset/art-style.json)
description: Art style slots for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 dataset rows. Empty or omitted patterns emit one row without an art style slot.

patterns.description: One generated row per pattern, after pose.

prompt.description: Short natural-language slot joined into the edit instruction and caption. Not a full sentence and not Danbooru tags (e.g. as an anime illustration).
